_comment: Claude Desktop → OmniMind. PREFERRED: Claude Desktop shares Claude.ai's connector list — add the hosted server once as a custom connector (see claude-ai-connector.md; the header field under Advanced settings depends on your plan, and the OAuth path is shown first when the operator has configured an issuer). If your plan's dialog has no header field and OAuth is not configured, merge mcpServers.omnimind (the hosted URL bridged with mcp-remote — no header field needed, token from BoardRoom Settings → Connected AI tools) into ~/.config/claude/claude_desktop_config.json (Linux) or ~/Library/Application Support/Claude/claude_desktop_config.json (macOS). LEGACY (stdio): mcpServers.omnimind-personal runs the server in-process as agent claude-desktop-josh (josh-personal, rw, sourceWeight 0.85). OMNIMIND_MCP_AGENT_KEY is the omk_ key printed by keygen for THIS agent (sent as x-agent-key; OMNIMIND_MCP_STATIC_AGENT_KEY is honoured first when set); OMNIMIND_API_KEY is the shared service key. OMNIMIND_MCP_USER_ID is optional: the user the omnimind:// resources read as; tools always take userId explicitly.

hosted_connector.name: OmniMind
hosted_connector.scopes_recommended: memory:read (add memory:write after a week of dogfooding)
hosted_connector.authentication: OAuth sign-in when the server advertises an issuer (read-only by default); otherwise header `Authorization: Bearer omt_…` if the dialog offers a header field
